title: 10 000 Guaranies (Series H-K)

obverse.description:
Brown on multicolor underprint.
Portrait of Dr. José Gaspar Rodríguez de Francia to right, issuer name on top, face value on numbers and letters on top corners, on numbers at center, and in letters below. Serial #s black, increasing size vertical on left, horizontal on right. Both Paraguayan coat of arms on sides of face value in numbers.
obverse.lettering:
10MIL 10MIL
BANCO CENTRAL
DEL PARAGUAY
EL BANCO CENTRAL DEL PARAGUAY
RECONOCE ESTE BILLETE POR
10000
AÑO 2015
★ DIEZ ★ MIL ★ GUARANIES ★
ESTE BILETE TIENE CURSO LEGAL Y FUERZA CANCELATORIA ILIMITADA EN TODO EL TERRITORIO DE LA REPUBLICA (LEY 489 DEL 29 DE JUNIO DE 1995).
obverse.lettering_translation:
10 thousands
Central Bank of Paraguay
The Central Bank of Paraguay accepts this banknote for
Year 2015
Ten Thousand Guaranies
This banknote is legal tender and has unlimited cancellation power on all the Republic territory (Law # 489 from June 29th., 1995).

reverse.description:
Brown on multicolor.
Scene of the Independence Declaratory, country name on top, face value in numbers on all 4 corners, and on sides of image, in letters at bottom, in Guarani language.
reverse.lettering:
10000 REPUBLICA DEL PARAGUAY 10000
10000 10000
14 DE MAYO DE 1811
10000 PA SU GUARANI 10000
reverse.lettering_translation:
Republic of Paraguay
May 14th., 1811
Ten Thousand Guaranies (guarani language)
